values: A decision template for comparing automation opportunities using value, feasibility, strategic alignment, risk, technology landscape, and dependency readiness.
1. Capture each candidate in Opportunity Intake.
Describe the process and quantify volume, effort, error and impact.
Do not automate a poorly understood process.
Assess data sensitivity, decision impact, resilience, systems, APIs and planned change.
Higher value never cancels an unacceptable control gap.
Challenge assumptions and compare the portfolio, not isolated ideas.
Use the score to support—not replace—governance judgment.
Approve, reject, defer or request evidence; assign owner and target date.
High-risk AI requires proportionate testing and human oversight.
Yellow cells are inputs; blue/green/amber/red cells are calculated or risk signals.
Adjust weights in Scoring Model before portfolio use.
Revalidate after material process, data, platform or vendor change.
Suggested cadence: intake weekly; portfolio prioritization monthly; full refresh quarterly.
Retain rationale, not only the final score.
Decision sequence: Discover → Qualify → Risk & Architecture Gate → Prioritize → Pilot → Production → Monitor
